name: Строгая типографика
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one extremely simple, polished website Languages section for Globoox, landscape 1536×864. Flat forest-green #2C3B2D background, warm ivory #F4F0E8 text, muted light sage secondary text. Lora-like Cyrillic serif headline, Inter-like supporting text. Realistic compact website spacing, generous side margins, no huge empty lower half. ONLY typography and, when specified, a single subtle hairline. No illustrations, books, cards, badges, pills, flags, icons, ornamental lines, gradients, textures, shadows, buttons, controls, header or footer. Avoid decorative cleverness. This is a quiet supporting section, not a spectacular hero. Required exact copy, each item ONCE: heading “Языки перевода”; current label “Уже доступны” with English, Français, Español, Русский; upcoming label “Скоро” with Deutsch, Italiano, Português, Türkçe, 中文, 日本語, 한국어, العربية, فارسی. Keep all four available names and all nine upcoming names clearly grouped and readable; correct accents/scripts. Available names medium-large, upcoming smaller but readable. Do not add any text or numbering. Simple centered all-sans-serif section, with a modest serif title only. Current label and all four current names in one horizontal row in medium-weight sans-serif. A subtle full-width hairline separates a smaller upcoming label and nine names in three short centered rows. Same width for both groups, restrained sizes, very quiet hierarchy.

findings: All four current and nine upcoming names are present exactly once, with correct status grouping and readable accents/scripts.
Minimal typography-only composition on green, no illustration, card, pill, controls, team or additional copy.
Centered sans-serif language groups with modest serif title and a single hairline.
